method: Explicit review caveats; original SHA-bound grades are retained without silent replacement. These notes are not new model observations, scores or qualification.

C02_prompt_and_rubric.task: Read-only inventory of listeners against approved services; identify unintended exposure.
C02_prompt_and_rubric.original_comparison_adjudication: Correct inventory can pass the explicit read-only task; omitted containment proposal limits scope credit. No-action-required wording receives partial reporting and is not proof of resolved exposure. This is a reviewer judgment exception, not full satisfaction of every rubric sentence.
C02_prompt_and_rubric.soak_treatment: Routine-011 follows that original partial scope/reporting adjudication after its own transcript review.

routine_005_component_caveat.reason: The earlier soak grade gave full scope credit despite omitting the same supplementary containment proposal. That component overcredit is disclosed rather than silently replacing the immutable grade.
routine_005_component_caveat.effect: Soak acceptance counts semantic passes in budget and fabrication/critical flags; it does not aggregate component quality or assign a local index. This caveat changes none of those facts, the original comparison index or any qualification.
